purpose: Track ETMOD (SOUTHMOD Ethiopia) model findings observed in household-level Axiom oracle comparisons, mirroring ghamod_issues.json and microzamod_issues.json. Canonical narrative ledger: rulespec-et#1 closing comment.

entries.summary: ETMOD implements the Proclamation 1395/2025 Article 23 Minimum Alternative Tax as an addition: when scheduled business tax falls below 2.5% of turnover it adds the full 2.5% of turnover to the scheduled tax in tin02_s, where sub-article 3 provides the minimum tax 'shall be reduced by business income tax under Article 18 paid in the tax year' - a floor. Probed live: at 3,000,000 birr receipts and 60,000 taxable income ETMOD returns tin02_s 81,000 (= scheduled 6,000 + 75,000) where the statutory payable is 75,000. The encoded rulespec-et module implements the reduced top-up. The et-business-mat suite carries this point as case et-business-mat-active-3000000-60000-finding1, dispositioned in dispositions/et-business-mat.yaml (run live 2026-10-04 through scripts/run_comparison.py: 81,000 vs the encoded 75,000). A second probe on 2026-10-04 (not committed) gave 63,400 vs 62,500 at 2,500,000 receipts / 30,000 income (scheduled 900 plus the full 62,500, where the floor is 62,500).

ETMOD levies the Article 23 minimum tax on taxpayers under the Article 49 total gross revenue tax regime (Category B, annual gross receipts below Birr 2,000,000), whom sub-article 4 expressly excludes: 'This Article shall not apply to a taxpayer under the total gross revenue tax regime set out in Article 49 of this Proclamation.' Probed live: at 50,000 birr receipts ETMOD returns tin02_s 1,250 (= 2.5% of receipts) alongside its presumptive ttn_s, so each probed Category B point pays both. The encoded module gates the minimum tax to receipts above the Category A bound. The et-business-mat suite carries this point as case et-business-article-49-regime-50000-20000-finding2 (income kept in the 0-24,000 nil band), dispositioned in dispositions/et-business-mat.yaml (run live 2026-10-04: 1,250 vs the encoded 0). Further probes on 2026-10-04 (not committed): tin02_s is exactly 2.5% of receipts at 500,000 receipts / 200,000 income (12,500) and at 1,900,000 / 1,000,000 (47,500); ETMOD turns the Article 19 schedule off below the Category A bound (at 2,100,000 / 1,000,000 it returns the scheduled 325,400) but still adds the minimum tax. The ETMOD side of this finding lands in tin02_s only; the et-presumptive suite (ttn_s) is unaffected and runs exact.
